title: N Queens II
summary: Count placements of n queens on an n×n board such that no two share a row, column, or diagonal.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 9. Return a count, with no board arrangements in the output.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare the number of distinct valid placements, without identifying rotations or reflections.

statement: Count placements of n queens on an n×n board such that no two share a row, column, or diagonal. Distinct placements count separately even when related by a rotation or reflection.

examples.explanation: Every placement of two queens shares a row, column, or diagonal.
Ten different placements satisfy the attack restrictions.
Four placements remain after enforcing both diagonals and columns.

constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 9. Return a count, with no board arrangements in the output.
hints: Conceptual: Each row must contain exactly one queen.
Directional: Build one row at a time while tracking blocked columns and diagonals.
Implementation: Use bit masks for occupied columns and diagonal attacks. Shift the diagonal masks when descending to the next row.
complexityAnalysis: O(n!) search time and O(n) auxiliary recursion space.
